descriptions.zh:
§Y缇扬奇§!是我们最先遇到的外星物种，关于这种温顺的生物我们已经了解了很多。

这种太空生物可以访问某种较为低维度的亚空间，所以他们能轻易地在星系间穿行。他们以许多气态行星上层大气中的气体为食，但已经喜欢上了我们的果实。他们即便在受到惊扰的情况下几乎不会发起攻击。

这就是我们种子的完美载体：平静、无害甚至有点无聊。他们隐藏着什么秘密吗？
descriptions.en:
The §YTiyanki§! are the first alien species we encountered, and we already learned much about these docile creatures.

Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, these spaceborne lifeforms roam from system to system with remarkable ease. They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, but have taken a liking to our fruits. They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked.

The perfect carrier for our seeds: calm, innocuous, almost boring. Do they hide any secret?

label.zh: 把更多的时间花在他们的研究上。
label.en: Dedicate further time to their study.

label.zh: 我们还有更要紧的事情。

descriptions.zh: 通过对这些太空朋友进食习性的研究，我们的科学家获得了研究突破。改进缇扬奇提取气态物质的能量的方法，就有可能造出可以从敌方舰船中汲取能量的武器。。这项科技毫无疑问是非常有用的。
descriptions.en: By studying the feeding habits of our voidborne friends, our scientists have made a scientific breakthrough. Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.. This technology will doubtlessly prove useful.

descriptions.zh:
我们为星系的太空生物群建造了一座花园。我们让其中开满了鲜花，结满了果实和黏性的种荚，时刻准备着附着在这些令人惊叹的生物的皮肤上。但这些深居虚空的生灵们会出席我们的盛宴吗？当他们咬下第一口果实时，所有的担忧便已烟消云散。

从记事起，我们就已经在自己的星球上为各种动物提供果实与荫蔽。作为回报，它们替我们携带种子。如今，这一古老的契约被翻印到了星系的尺度上：太空生物将携带着我们的§Y种荚§!一同旅行。只要运气尚佳，我们的种子将会落在一颗§H可殖民行星§!上，并找到为我们的人民建造一座新花园所需的一切。我们只需要引导一道能量束将他们激活，就可以让我们无需派遣殖民船便可以定居到新的行星上。
descriptions.en:
For the galaxy's spaceborne fauna, we built a garden. We filled it with flowers, fruit and sticky seed pods, ready to latch to the skin of these magnificent creatures. But would these void-dwellers appreciate our banquet? As soon as they bit the first apple, our anxiety dissipated.

Since time immemorial, we have offered fruit and shade to the animals on our planet. In return, they carried our seeds. Now, this ancient pact has been replicated at a galactic scale: spaceborne fauna will carry our §YSeed Pods§! with them as they travel. With a little luck, our seeds will fall on a §Hcolonizable planet§! where they will have everything they need to establish a new garden for our people. We need only direct an energy beam to activate them, allowing us to inhabit new planets without having to send a colony ship.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[this.GetName]§!的殖民地正在被超授粉的种子球轰炸。森林在世界各地快速增生，地面撕裂、建筑倒毁，[this.GetPlanetHabitat]上现在到处都是迅速生长的外星植物。
descriptions.en: Our colony on §H[this.GetName]§! is being bombarded with hyper-fertilized balls of seeds. New forests are sprouting everywhere, cracking floors, ruining buildings and filling the [this.GetPlanetHabitat] with rapid-growing xenoflora.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
太空兽群虽然能帮我们散播§Y种荚§!，但还是不如最近加入舰队的新成员来得靠谱。

我们的§Y星种花园§!会给麾下的生物分发种子，然后我们就能直接派它们前往§H适合殖民的星球§!，在那里开辟出新的花园。
descriptions.en:
Though we can rely on wild space fauna to spread our §YSeed Pods§!, we can do so more reliably with those who have recently joined our fleets.

Our §YStarseed Gardens§! will distribute seeds to creatures within our fold, whom we can then send directly to §Hcolonizable planets§! to establish a new garden.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们打开了在§H[from.GetName]§!的§Y种荚§!，新生的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始生根发芽。
descriptions.en: Our §YSeed Pod§! on §H[from.GetName]§! opened, and the newly born [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun to dig roots.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetName]上的土壤里散落着似乎不属于当地生态系统的种子。在最低限度的光照和水分下，种子迅速地生长，新生的森林迅速包裹了整个行星，促进了我们的殖民活动。

根据我们的基因分析，这些生长快速的基因工程种子是由§Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!研发的。
descriptions.en:
The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.

According to our genetic analysis, these fast-growing, bio-engineered seeds have been developed by the §Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: [this.GetName]上的土壤里散落着似乎不属于当地生态系统的种子。在最低限度的光照和水分下，种子迅速地生长，新生的森林迅速包裹了整个行星，促进了我们的殖民活动。。我们的科学家无法分析这些种子的来源，但可以肯定一点：它们一定是经过人工基因修饰的，可以在外星土壤上快速扎根。
descriptions.en: The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.. Our scientists have been unable to determine the origin of the seeds, but one thing is certain: they are artificial in nature, bio-engineered to quickly take root in alien soil.

得益于这些种荚中的通讯系统，我们可以很快与这些种子的发源地帝国建立联络。
descriptions.en:
The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.

Thanks to the communication system in the seed pods, we were able to quickly establish contact with the empire the seed germinated from.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船刚刚着陆于§H[from.GetName]§!，但我们休眠的人民早已深深扎根在土壤中了。§Y种荚§!中所附带的额外[root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和资源将有助于我们在这颗星球上的殖民地发展。

祝愿他们根深叶茂。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship just landed §H[from.GetName]§!, but our people were already there, lying dormant in the soil. The additional [root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and resources contained in the §YSeed Pod§! will help our colonists develop the planet.

May their roots spread far and wide.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的遥远[owner.GetColonistPlural]在恒星附近部署了一座§Y哨站§!，从而获得了§Y[Root.GetStarName]§!恒星系的控制权。
descriptions.en: Our distant [owner.GetColonistPlural] on §Y[Root.GetName]§! deployed an §YOutpost§! around the star, gaining control of the §Y[Root.GetStarName]§! system.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们与太空生物的关系相当独特，但我们并不是唯一尊重它们生存权的人。星海共同体刚刚通过的一项议案将有助于保护这些奇妙生物。
descriptions.en: Our relationship with spaceborne creatures is fairly unique, but we are not alone in respecting their right to exist; a resolution that has just passed in the Galactic Community will help protect the lives of these wondrous creatures.

descriptions.zh: 太空生物一直是我们的朋友，但并非所有的星海共同体成员都像我们一样热爱这些太空生物。他们刚刚通过的决议将我们的朋友——以及我们自己——的生命置于危险之中。
descriptions.en: Spaceborne creatures have always be our friends, but not all members of the Galactic Community share our love for the void-dwellers. The resolution they just passed puts the livelihood of our friends - and ours - at a risk.

descriptions.zh:
我们的敌人认为我们会屈服于他们的力量，就像被风吹倒的芦苇一样。他们忘记了植物有刺。

我们的士兵睡在他们的土地上。如果有需要，我们可以将我们的§H外星入侵植物§!转变为陆军，保护我们的一切，扼杀他们所谓的他们拥有的东西。我们只需将能量束引导到指定的行星即可开始我们的入侵行动。
descriptions.en:
Our enemies think we will bend to their strength, like reeds blown down by the wind. They forget that plants have thorns.

Our soldiers sleep in their ground. Should the need arise, we can turn our §HInvasive Xenoflora§! into armies, to protect what is ours and to strangle what they call their own. We need only to direct an energy beam to the desired planet in order to begin our invasion.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: §H[from.GetName]§!上的§H外星入侵植物§!突然长出肢体变成了一支军队。这颗行星正在遭到攻击！
descriptions.en: The §HInvasive Xenoflora§! on §H[from.GetName]§! suddenly sprouted limbs, turning into an army. The planet is under attack!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
